purpose: The read-only Azure DevOps MCP server that supplies requirement, hierarchy, acceptance-criteria and linked Test Case context. Admitting it as a locally installed, lockfile-resolved dependency replaces the previous runtime `npx -y` acquisition, which resolved and executed a package from the network at every session start.

rejectedAlternatives.whyInsufficient: Runtime package acquisition executes whatever the registry serves at start time. The version is pinned but the fetch is not, `-y` suppresses the install prompt, and an offline or degraded network breaks the workflow silently. §19.6.4 names this exact pattern as debt to remediate, not to copy.

rejectedAlternatives.alternative: a hand-written Azure DevOps REST client using Node built-ins
rejectedAlternatives.whyInsufficient: The workspace consumes work items, hierarchies, wiki pages, test plans and project-scoped search across four domains. Reimplementing that surface — with its auth, paging and revision semantics — would be a larger, less reviewed attack surface than the vendor server, and it would drift from the tool schemas the agent-facing contracts pin.

provenance.maintainerNote: Published by Microsoft under the @azure-devops scope; the repository follows Microsoft's Coordinated Vulnerability Disclosure process through MSRC.
provenance.note: Provenance is evidence of origin, not proof of benign content. The server is policy-bound to read actions by the safety hook and role guard; it has no server-side read-only mode.

sources: npm audit against this repository's lockfile (measured 2026-08-05)
advisoryCheck.detail: Measured, not asserted: `npm audit` reports 12 moderate / 0 high both before and after this dependency joined the lock — identical counts and identical advisory ids (GHSA-8988-4f7v-96qf, GHSA-gh4j-gqv2-49f6, both in the pre-existing @salesforce/mcp telemetry chain). A standalone install of @azure-devops/mcp@2.8.1 DOES pull @modelcontextprotocol/sdk on a vulnerable @hono/node-server <2.0.5 (GHSA-frvp-7c67-39w9, Windows path traversal in serve-static via encoded %5C). In this repository the pre-existing `@hono/node-server: ^2.0.5` override resolves it to 2.0.11, and the advisory is verifiably absent from the tree. That override is therefore load-bearing for this admission and must not be removed without re-running this check.

lifecycleScripts.note: Installed and verified with `npm ci --ignore-scripts`; the offline start proof runs against that install. No lifecycle script from this package or its tree is executed.

cooldown.reason: 2.8.1 is the version this workspace has already been launching through npx since the 2026-07-14 owner decision; it is not a new release being adopted early. This admission changes the acquisition path, not the version.

rollbackCriterion: Remove or re-review if the @hono/node-server override is dropped or stops resolving >=2.0.5, if an advisory affecting 2.8.1 or its tree appears, if the transitive delta digest changes without a fresh admission, or if the ADO read surface is retired. Rollback is reverting to the previous release, never re-enabling runtime `npx -y`.
